unionRateLookup.findings: Current union minimums, tier structures, and classification requirements for a major feature film have been verified. Rates used in this calculation meet or exceed all applicable minimum standards for the assumed jurisdictions (UK/USA).

baseWageCalculation.methodology: Base wages calculated based on negotiated rates for ATL talent and departmental crew heads. BTL crew wages based on standard weekly rates for a 49-week period (12 weeks prep, 30.6 weeks shoot, 6.4 weeks wrap, rounded up). Cast wages calculated based on guaranteed weeks derived from the optimized schedule phases. Prep and wrap periods are fully factored for all departments.

overtimeEstimation.methodology: A blended overtime rate of 30% has been applied to the BTL crew base wages, reflecting the high number of long shoot days (10-12+ hours), night shoots, and complex setups. A specific allowance for meal penalties and potential turnaround violations is included.
factors: DAY_TO_NIGHT transitions requiring extended lighting setups.
Forced call potential during Africa-to-Studio transition.

ratesApplied.description: Applied to all ATL and BTL Cast.

locationMultiplierProcessing.methodology: Costs associated with the Phase 1 (Africa) remote location shoot have been calculated and added.

allowances.notes: Airfare, lodging, and local transport for 75 cast/crew for 28 days.

Administrative and logistical support for international work.

talent.notes: 16-week guarantee @ $50k/wk. Includes $50k adjustment for zero-g/aging makeup.

director.notes: Negotiated flat fee for directing services.

producer.notes: Producer fee (assumes Director is also primary producer).

extras.notes: 450 man-days @ $250/day avg, includes bumps for makeup/performance.

stunts.notes: Stunt Coordinator (15 wks @ $5k) + 4 performers (10 wks @ $3k) + adjustments.

specialCasting.notes: Allowance for unlisted speaking roles, child actors, and their welfare/tutoring.

crew.notes: Crew costs include base pay and 44.8% UK fringe rate. Overtime is listed separately.

overtimeAndPenalties.notes: Calculated at 30% of BTL crew base pay, plus an allowance for penalties.

locationAndTravel.notes: Costs associated with the Africa location shoot.

specializedLaborContingency.notes: Contingency for labor related to high-risk areas: Zero-G rigging safety crew, additional SFX/VFX technicians for R&D, and stunt rigging specialists.

costEscalationFactors.description: Pioneering VFX work (Stargate, zero-g) carries a high risk of R&D overruns and requiring more on-set supervision and labor than budgeted.
The operational complexity of the rotating centrifuge set could lead to downtime, requiring crew standby costs and potential overtime to catch up.
A 145-day shoot increases exposure to potential union rate increases mid-production and general cost inflation.
Work with wild animals can cause unpredictable delays, leading to crew overtime and extended location costs.

recommendedContingency.notes: A 12% contingency on total Below-The-Line costs is recommended to mitigate the identified labor-related risks.
